positions.title: Designer/Web Developer
positions.description:
treetree delivers creative firepower for B2B giants to help the world's busiest marketing and sales teams shine when it’s go time.
 
By understanding your organization’s challenges and goals, we offer strategic, digital and creative solutions that do more than just execute – they elevate. Whether it’s building sales tools for your next product launch, creating fresh content for your social team or developing your next demand gen digital program, our content, strategy, digital and creative offerings are the powerhouse support and fresh thinking you need to confidently say "yes" to new initiatives.
 
treetree is an independently owned Certified Women's Business Enterprise.

Web design and programming

WordPress development and content management

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Lead UI Designer for the StreamOne Cloud Solution Store and Tech Data Cloud.
Conduct user focus groups and usability tests
Provide direction to UI Designers
Work with business team to determine project requirements
Work with in house ad agency to create designs inline with branding standards

Implement HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Recommend software applications and technology solutions for ecommerce platform

Lead technology workshops for community out reach, teach HTML/CSS
